text:
anna_pm: Quick sync — pricing v2 rollout: we need a clear owner for the metering adapter change and the billing ledger mapping. target: EOD Wed for PR and ownership handoff. who can take the metering hook?

sam_eng: I can pick up the metering adapter integration if no one else is queued. estimate ~1.5d to get adapter + unit tests. will need final schema from billing.

maria_billing: Thanks Sam. I own the ledger mapping. I can send the schema and example events by EOD today. note: there are contract constraints around invoice granularity (monthly vs usage) — chris_legal is cc'd for any gotchas.

lee_metering: Heads up — the current KV cache behavior for prefix caching changes token accounting. Sam, if you touch prefix cache you'll need to increment the metering event field `cache_hit_adjustment` so billable tokens stay accurate.

sam_eng: good note Lee. where should that field live? in events.top_level or metadata?

maria_billing: Put it in events.usage_adjustments.cache_hits — billing pipeline already reads that path in V2. I'll include it in the schema doc.

chris_legal: Quick check: contract terms require preserving `price_id` mapping per contract. If any rollout changes default price mapping, we need a migration plan and customer notice. Avoid changing `price_id` semantics.

anna_pm: @chris_legal noted. Maria — can you confirm the mapping is additive (new price ids only) and no remap?

maria_billing: Confirmed — additive only. We'll create new price ids and keep legacy mapping. Migration plan: 2-week dual-read, feature flag `pricing.v2.enabled` to switch.

sam_eng: For code rollout plan: implement adapter behind feature flag `pricing.v2.enabled` -> integration tests -> canary on dev -> canary on staging -> enable in prod for 10% -> ramp. Need deploy-bot to create canary release.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging-canary `pricing-v2-adapter` at 2026-03-18T02:00Z. Notify #eng-releases on merge.

lee_metering: One dependency: quota service needs to accept `quota_key` change: new plan-based quotas for pricing-v2. @quota-team FYI — schema change is minimal: add `plan_id` to quota key. Backwards compatible.

anna_pm: Ownership summary: Sam = metering adapter implementation, Maria = ledger mapping/schema + billing readme, Lee = meter semantics + quota key change, Chris = legal signoff on migration wording. Sam/Maria/Lee please post PR links when ready. I'll track in the roadmap ticket. :thumbsup:

sam_eng: will post PR by EOD Tue and ping for review. CC @eng-oncall for potential perf regressions.

maria_billing: sending schema link now: https://example.internal/schemas/pricing-v2-schema.md (draft)

chris_legal: I'll review migration wording tomorrow and flag any customers needing opt-in.

anna_pm: Perfect. If anything blocks Sam (schema gaps, test infra), call it out here. Otherwise I'll close this sync and move to async updates.

sam_eng: all good for now, thanks!
